pages.title: vaultofcodes
pages.description:
VaultofCodes is one of India’s fastest-growing edtech platforms, trusted by over 30,000 learners nationwide. We specialize in delivering live, hands-on tech training and certified internships designed to build real, job-ready skills. From web development and data science to app development, UI/UX, Python, and Java, our programs are tailored for students and professionals seeking practical, industry-aligned learning.

Officially listed on AICTE’s National Internship Portal, partnered with Google for Education, and featured on Internshala, VaultofCodes is committed to turning learners into doers — through mentorship, projects, and support that bridges the gap between education and employment.

pages.description:
🔹Career-Ready training & Internship Webinar

Industry-oriented training and internship programs 

🔹 What to Expect: 
✅ Program structure & training path overview  
✅ Internship & certification details  
✅ Success stories from past interns  
✅ Batches & Enrollment Process
✅ Internship Requirements
✅ Free Career Consultation & Guidance
✅ Live Q&A – Ask us anything!

🔹 Ideal For: 
- College students  
- Recent graduates  
- Career switchers  
- Beginners in tech

⭐DETAILS:👇

✅Start Date: Immediately after registration 
✅Internship Duration: 1/2/3/4 month
✅Recorded Lectures + Live Classes

⭐BENEFITS:👇

✅Internship Completion Certificate with QR code verification
✅Training Completion Certificate
✅50GB+ Study Material
✅50% Coupon on all courses from VaultofCodes
✅Group Internship! Get Trained & Work on Projects with Friends | Get Certified Together

⭐TRAINING CONTENT:👇

🔴Introduction to Python and Basics
     1. Introduction to Python
         -Overview of Python and its applications
     2. Variables, Data Types, and Operators
         -Understanding variables and data types (integers, 
         floats, strings, etc.)
         -Basic arithmetic and comparison operators
     3. Control Structures
         -Conditional Statements (if, elif, else)
         -Loops (for and while)

🔴Data Structures and Modules
     1. Functions and File Handling
         -Defining and using functions
         -Reading and writing files in Python
     2. Lists, Tuples, and Dictionaries
         -Working with lists and tuples
         -Introduction to dictionaries

🔴Data Structures
     1. Advanced Data Structures
         -Sets and frozen sets
         -Understanding comprehensions (list 
           comprehensions, etc.)
     2. Introduction to Classes and Objects
         -Defining classes and creating objects
         -Attributes and methods

🔴Object-Oriented Programming
     1. Inheritance and Polymorphism
         -Extending classes through inheritance
         -Overriding methods for polymorphism
     2. Encapsulation and Abstraction
         -Using encapsulation to restrict access to certain 
           parts of an object
         -Understanding abstraction for managing complexity

🔴Error Handling, Modules, and Conclusion
     1. Exception Handling
         -Handling exceptions and errors
         -Using try, except, and finally blocks
     2. Project Presentation and Best Practices
         -Discuss a project(to-do list, tic-tac-toe, password 
           manager, etc)
         -Discuss best practices for Python programming
